description: This file defines the SiteForCookies class, which manages the concept of same-site origins for cookies, including schemeful and schemeless policies, comparison methods, and serialization support within the Chromium project.

classes.name: SiteForCookies
classes.description: Represents and manages the concept of a site for cookie policies, including schemeful and schemeless considerations, comparison, and serialization.

methods.name: FromWire
methods.description: Constructs a SiteForCookies instance from potentially untrusted RPC values.

methods.name: FromOrigin
methods.description: Creates a SiteForCookies instance from a URL origin.

methods.name: FromUrl
methods.description: Creates a SiteForCookies instance from a URL.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SiteForCookies instance.

methods.name: IsFirstParty
methods.description: Determines if a URL is considered first-party relative to this site.

methods.name: IsFirstPartyWithSchemefulMode
methods.description: Determines first-party status considering scheme compatibility.

methods.name: IsEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if two SiteForCookies instances are equivalent.

methods.name: CompareWithFrameTreeSiteAndRevise
methods.description: Revises the SiteForCookies based on frame tree origin comparison.

methods.name: CompareWithFrameTreeOriginAndRevise
methods.description: Converts an origin to SchemefulSite and compares with frame tree site.

methods.name: RepresentativeUrl
methods.description: Returns a URL that is first-party to this SiteForCookies.

methods.name: site
methods.description: Accessor for the underlying SchemefulSite object.

methods.name: scheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme of the site.

methods.name: registrable_domain
methods.description: Returns the registrable domain of the site.

methods.name: schemefully_same
methods.description: Indicates if the site is schemefully same.

methods.name: SetSchemefullySameForTesting
methods.description: Sets the schemefully_same flag for testing purposes.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the SiteForCookies matches nothing.
